title: faux mistletoe ball
text: faux mistletoe ball. Wow.  I knew I was purchased a "faux" mistletoe ball, but this was horrid.  It arrived in a thin plastic box, inside of a paper mailing envelope.  This is NOT a quality product and it was completely destroyed.  There is a very crudely applied glitter that doesn't cover the the ball.. but looks like it was thrown at it at odd angles..  The red "berries" were all at the bottom of the thin plastic box.. I might have been able to reattach some of them, but honestly, it was so gross looking - smashed flat... that I couldn't see the point of trying that.  It went right into the trash bin.  Sad, but live and learn.
